verdict.rationale: Synthesia's own API docs say users can use Synthesia MCP to create and find videos from AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT without calling the API directly. That is an official, first-party MCP server that agents can connect to. The evidence is a single brief mention, though, so the depth of the capability is not shown. Missing for 10: setup/connection documentation, tool inventory and auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
